decisions.meaning: 东方财富可转债记录中的当前转股状态标记，原始值为“是/否”。在保留样本中，该状态与同一响应记录的转股开始日、转股结束日及采集观察时点相符；它表示当前是否处于可转股期间，不是债券是否具有转股条款的静态属性。具体盘中切换时刻和接口刷新规则未公开。
decisions.rationale: The official Eastmoney convertible-bond detail page and its page script identify the same-record TRANSFER_START_DATE and TRANSFER_END_DATE as the transfer start and end dates, but do not directly document IS_CONVERT_STOCK. Across the retained corpus, 9,978/9,980 valid same-record observations fall within the inclusive transfer-period dates. The two date-only exceptions were observed at 08:01 before trading on the start date and 20:07 after close on the end date; both align with the current status at the capture time. Five observed status transitions occur at the corresponding start/end period edges. The 20 excluded observations all belong to one record without status or transfer dates. This supports current conversion-period status, not a static convertible-clause attribute; exact intraday switch and refresh rules remain unspecified. No cross-source mapping is asserted.

sample.scope: 2026-10-16..2026-11-20 observation timestamps; retained raw_event_dc.json RPT_BOND_CB_LIST records; same-record convertible_bonds[].IS_CONVERT_STOCK compared with TRANSFER_START_DATE and TRANSFER_END_DATE, using request-completed fetched_at for boundary interpretation.
